posts.title: Three pillars: Formal Verification in the age of agentic engineering
posts.description: What can formal verification tell us about our designs before we start coding? An introduction to formal verification for event-driven architectures and an exploration of how far the domain models we already write can take us towards TLA+. A first independent experiment with ZFL and ZDL suggests about a third of the way today, and two thirds or more with a few additional conventions, with caveats.

posts.title: Three pillars: Domain-Driven Design as Code
posts.description: Domain-Driven Design gives us the tools and the mental frame to understand the business. The challenge now is to write those findings down as a spec both humans and agents can work on. EventStorming in its two sizes: process-level and design-level, and two languages that turn them into code: ZFL and ZDL.
